papers.title: Nexus: An Agentic Framework for Time Series Forecasting
papers.what: Multi-agent pipeline decomposes TS forecasting into trend, residual, and context agents; matches or beats SOTA TSFMs on post-cutoff data.

papers.title: Understanding Emergent Misalignment via Feature Superposition Geometry
papers.what: Geometric explanation for emergent misalignment: fine-tuning leaks into superposed harmful features. Geometry-aware filtering cuts misalignment 34.5%.

papers.title: Efficient Pre-Training with Token Superposition
papers.what: Drop-in method combines contiguous tokens into bags for 2-3x pretraining speedup at matched FLOPs. Validated 270M to 10B-A1B MoE.

papers.title: Fast Training of MoE for Time Series Forecasting via Expert Loss Integration
papers.what: MoE for TS with expert-specific loss in routing plus partial online learning; beats Transformers and WaveNet on economic/energy data.
